characters.summary: Seymour is an elephant-seal Muppet who works as an elevator operator and aspiring performer on Muppets Tonight. He fights mainly through persistence, physical awkwardness, and comedic musical routines.
weaknesses: Prone to stage fright and rejection

sources.supports: Role as an elevator operator and performer on Muppets Tonight, abilities, and characteristics.

unknowns: Full extent of physical capabilities outside of standard Muppet comedy sketches.

characters.summary: Sherlock Hemlock is a self-proclaimed 'world's greatest detective' who investigates mysteries using a magnifying glass. While enthusiastic, his deductive reasoning is comically flawed, often missing obvious solutions.

mechanisms: Avoidance through disguise or running away

limitations: No combat magic or special powers

sources.supports: Role as a detective, use of magnifying glass, and flawed reasoning skills.

unknowns: Whether any of his deductions are ever genuinely correct without sheer coincidence.

characters.summary: Slimey the Worm is Oscar the Grouch's pet worm. He is exceptionally small, relies on crawling and burrowing, and participates in various tiny adventures, sometimes utilizing miniature vehicles.

mechanisms: Microscopic size making him hard to target

weaknesses: Extremely fragile due to small size
Vulnerable to ordinary environmental hazards like rain or being stepped on
limitations: Lacks offensive capabilities against standard-sized opponents

sources.supports: Size, relationship with Oscar the Grouch, and burrowing habits.

campaignTags.claim: Pilots miniature vehicles designed for worms

unknowns: Exact physical strength limits at worm scale.

characters.summary: Spa'am is the high priest of the Wild Boar worshippers on the island in Muppet Treasure Island. He engages in tribal rituals, can command wild boars, and wields primitive ritual items.

mechanisms: Protection by tribal followers and wild boars

weaknesses: Relies heavily on his tribe and followers for security
limitations: Dependent on tribal influence and local environment

sources.supports: Role as high priest in Muppet Treasure Island, boar-worshipping tribe leader.

unknowns: Extent of magical powers beyond tribal rituals.

characters.summary: Sprocket is a large, loyal dog belonging to Doc in Fraggle Rock. He investigates Fraggles, barks to alert his owner, and uses canine physicality to defend his territory or interact with mechanical objects.
weaknesses: Easily distracted by food or Fraggles
limitations: Limited to standard dog physical capabilities

sources.supports: Sprocket's role as Doc's dog in Fraggle Rock, physical traits, and interactions with Fraggles.

unknowns: Whether he can operate complex machinery despite attempts to help Doc.

characters.summary: Statler is one half of the iconic balcony heckling duo alongside Waldorf. He fights exclusively with sharp verbal wit, insults, and sarcastic commentary from a distance.

mechanisms: Seating high up in the theater balcony out of reach

mobility: Walking to and from the balcony seats
limitations: Physically frail and immobile during altercations

sources.supports: Statler's role as a heckler on The Muppet Show, balcony location, and verbal combat style.

unknowns: How he and Waldorf manage to appear in seemingly unrelated locations just to heckle.

characters.summary: The Swedish Chef is a chaotic culinary artist who wields various kitchen implements—most notably knives, whisks, and occasionally firearms or explosives—to prepare bizarre meals amid flying food.

techniques: Melee weapon strikes with cleavers and knives

weaknesses: Prone to injuring himself with his own cooking tools and weapons
limitations: Weapons are limited to standard kitchen gear

sources.supports: Use of kitchen knives, chaotic cooking methods, and characteristic props on The Muppet Show.

unknowns: The exact nature of the ingredients he uses and their potential chemical properties.

characters.summary: Sweetums is a massive, towering ogre Muppet who possesses immense physical strength. He fights primarily through brute force, smashing objects, lifting heavy loads, and intimidating opponents with his size and roars.

mechanisms: High physical durability against blunt force

weaknesses: Low intellect makes him susceptible to trickery
Relatively slow movement speed compared to agile opponents
limitations: Lacks ranged attacks or magical abilities

sources.supports: Sweetums' immense physical size, strength as an ogre, and role in The Muppet Show.

campaignTags.claim: Stands around 9 feet tall with immense ogre strength

unknowns: The exact upper limit of his lifting capacity.

characters.summary: Telly Monster is an anxious, high-strung triangle-obsessed monster on Sesame Street. He fights with erratic bursts of frantic energy, occasionally using triangles or musical instruments as makeshift tools.
weaknesses: Prone to severe panic attacks and hypochondria
limitations: No formal combat training or superpowers

sources.supports: Telly Monster's anxious personality, triangle obsession, and physical traits on Sesame Street.

unknowns: Whether his obsession with triangles provides any tactical advantage.

characters.summary: The Amazing Mumford is a stage magician on Sesame Street who casts spells using his magic wand and the iconic catchphrase 'A la peanut butter sandwiches!' His spells frequently misfire or produce chaotic, unintended magical transformations.

mechanisms: Magical shields or turning opponents into harmless objects (when spells work)

weaknesses: Extremely unreliable magic; spells frequently backfire or produce wrong results
Requires verbal incantation and wand gestures
limitations: Spell success rate is highly unpredictable

sources.supports: Role as a magician on Sesame Street, magic wand, and 'A la peanut butter sandwiches!' catchphrase.

campaignTags.claim: Casts magic spells using a wand and incantations

unknowns: Whether he can cast spells without his wand or specific catchphrase.
